segments.sn12.10:1.1: “Pubbeva me, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi –
segments.sn12.10:1.2: ‘kicchaṃ vatāyaṃ loko āpanno jāyati ca jīyati ca mīyati ca cavati ca upapajjati ca.
segments.sn12.10:1.3: Atha ca panimassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ nappajānāti jarāmaraṇassa.
segments.sn12.10:1.4: Kudāssu nāma imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyissati jarāmaraṇassā’”ti?
segments.sn12.10:2.2: ‘kimhi nu kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti, kiṃpaccayā jarāmaraṇan’ti?
segments.sn12.10:2.3: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo –
segments.sn12.10:2.4: ‘jātiyā kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇan’”ti.
segments.sn12.10:3.2: ‘kimhi nu kho sati jāti hoti … pe … bhavo … upādānaṃ … taṇhā … vedanā … phasso … saḷāyatanaṃ … nāmarūpaṃ … viññāṇaṃ … saṅkhārā honti, kiṃpaccayā saṅkhārā’ti?
segments.sn12.10:3.12: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo –
segments.sn12.10:3.13: ‘avijjāya kho sati saṅkhārā honti, avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā’”ti.
segments.sn12.10:4.2: saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
segments.sn12.10:4.4: ‘Samudayo, samudayo’ti kho me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi.
segments.sn12.10:5.2: ‘kimhi nu kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā jarāmaraṇanirodho’ti?
segments.sn12.10:5.3: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo –
segments.sn12.10:5.4: ‘jātiyā kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇanirodho’”ti.
segments.sn12.10:6.2: ‘kimhi nu kho asati jāti na hoti … pe … bhavo … upādānaṃ … taṇhā … vedanā … phasso … saḷāyatanaṃ … nāmarūpaṃ … viññāṇaṃ … saṅkhārā na honti, kissa nirodhā saṅkhāranirodho’ti?
segments.sn12.10:6.12: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo –
segments.sn12.10:6.13: ‘avijjāya kho asati saṅkhārā na honti, avijjānirodhā saṅkhāranirodho’”ti.
segments.sn12.10:7.2: saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti.
segments.sn12.10:7.4: ‘Nirodho, nirodho’ti kho me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādī”ti.

lines: 5-10. Pañcamādīsu sikhissa, bhikkhavetiādīnaṃ padānaṃ “sikhissapi, bhikkhave”ti na evaṃ yojetvā attho veditabbo.
Nānāṭhānesu hi etāni desitāni, attho pana sabbattha sadisoyeva.
Sabbabodhisattānañhi bodhipallaṅke nisinnānaṃ na añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā ācikkhati –
Yathā pana paṭhamakappikakāle deve vuṭṭhe udakassa gatamaggeneva aparāparaṃ vuṭṭhiudakaṃ gacchati, evaṃ tehi tehi purimabuddhehi gatamaggeneva pacchimā pacchimā gacchanti.
Sabbabodhisattā hi ānāpānacatutthajjhānato vuṭṭhāya paccayākāre ñāṇaṃ otāretvā taṃ anulomapaṭilomaṃ sammasitvā buddhā hontīti paṭipāṭiyā sattasu suttesu buddhavipassanā nāma kathitāti.
5-10. Na evaṃ yojetvāti “sikhissapī”tiādinā samuccayavasena evaṃ na yojetvā.
Ekāsane adesitattāti vuttamevatthaṃ pākaṭaṃ kātuṃ “nānāṭhānesu hī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Yadipi tāni visuṃ visuṃ vuttabhāvena desitāni, atthavaṇṇanā pana ekasadisā tadatthassa abhinnattā.
Na hi mahābodhisattānaṃ pacchimabhave paropadesena payojanaṃ atthi.
Gatamaggenevāti paṭipattigamanena gatamaggeneva pacchimamahābodhisattā gacchanti, ayamettha dhammatā.
Gacchantīti catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu patiṭṭhitacittā satta bojjhaṅge yāthāvato bhāvetvā sammāsambodhiyā abhisambujjhanavasena pavattantīti attho.
Yathā pana tesaṃ paṭhamavipassanābhiniveso hoti, taṃ dassetuṃ “sabbabodhisattā hī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
